A sturdier app around the model, and a stricter podcast proxy.

**Use it now:** [vemsavad.app](https://vemsavad.app) (Chrome or Edge). The old address,
vemsavad.promptagency.se, redirects there.

### Fixed
- Damaged saved transcripts (missing text, broken or missing timestamps) now load and export instead of
  showing NaN or breaking the review view.
- Subtitles are valid for any text: no `00:00:59,1000` from rounding, no blank lines splitting a cue, a
  `-->` in what someone said can't pose as a timing line, and WebVTT escapes `& < >`.
- Markdown shows indented list-like lines literally, and file names drop control characters.
- An absurd recording length (a broken file header) no longer hangs speaker separation.
- Podcast feeds with negative or nonsense durations no longer show odd times.

### Privacy and security
- The podcast proxy only connects to ports 80 and 443, refuses user names and passwords in links, and blocks
  more private and reserved address ranges.
- The visit count goes through the site itself, so the page talks to no analytics host. What is counted is
  unchanged — see "Räknar ni besök?" in the FAQ.

### Hosting it yourself
`vem-sa-vad-v1.2.0.zip` below is the built site. Its `proxy.php` has the same stricter rules as the hosted
proxy. See [docs/hosting.md](https://github.com/promptagency/vem-sa-vad/blob/main/docs/hosting.md).

Built on [Bjarbys Transcriber](https://github.com/fltman/bjarbys-transcriber) by Anders Bjarby (MIT).
